movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Natural movement for balance, no defined gestures
movement_profile.footwork: Rapid, repeated leg fluttering in place

signature_moves.description: Alternating rapid leg lifts resembling butterfly wings
signature_moves.name: Flutter legs

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid excessive upper body tension Avoid off-beat leg movements

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated, percussive beats typical of Dancehall music
music_profile.sound_description: The music features fast-paced, syncopated rhythms with electronic percussion and bass, supporting the fluttering leg movements of the dance.

basic_steps: Lift legs alternately with a fluttering motion
Keep knees slightly bent for flexibility
Maintain rhythmic timing with music beats
Use arms naturally for balance without specific gestures
teaching.level_notes: Beginner dancers start by practicing leg fluttering slowly to the beat before increasing speed
teaching.rhythm: Syncopated, fast-paced rhythm matching Dancehall music
